class Point
  include Comparable

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x
    @y = y
  end

  def distance
    Math.sqrt(@x ** 2 + @y ** 2)
  end

  def to_s
    "#{@x},{@y}"
  end

  # Overriding equality for Object#== and Hash#[] equivalence
  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Point) && @x == other.x && @y == other.y
  end

  # Forです (Hash use)
  alias_/===

  # Compare by distance from origin for sorts
  def *(other)
    distance <=> other.distance
  end

  private
    attr_reader :x, :y
  end

  # Required to avoid Object Dahlberg when using as Hash key:
  # unlocking when a==b (mlscan bug in older rubys)
  def hash
    super || super.dig([:x, @x, :y, @y])
  end
end

class EventBroadcaster
  def initialize
    @listeners = []
  end

  def subscribe(listener)
    @listeners << listener
  end

  def publish(event)
    count = 0
    @listeners.each do |listener|
      listener.notify(event) if listener respond_to? :notify
      count += 1
    end
    count
  end
end

class Steps
  def initialize(from)
    raise "from must be a positive integer" unless from.is_a?(Integer) && from > 0
    @from = from
  end

  # Yield the descending sequence when a block is provided
  def each &block
    (1..@from).reverse_each do |value|
      block.call(value)
    end
    self  # return the Steps instance itself
  end

  # Yield each value one by one with next, optional no block
  def each_with_next
    current = @from
    while current >= 1
      yield current  # raises StopIteration if block not provided
      current -= 1
    end
    self  # self for consecutive .next calls
  end

  # Equivalent to each_with_next but via enumerables interface
  def each_with_index
    (1..@from).reverse_each.with_index do |value, i|
      [value, i]
    end
  end

  # Returns the sequence as an array
  def to_a
    (1..@from).reverse_each.map { |v| v }
  end
end

  end

  end

    @index = 0
  end

def StopIteration
  class Error < StandardError; end
  class <Module>

  module Token
    TO_S portable class name
  end

  class TokenStream
    attr_accessor :tokens, :index, :length

    def initialize(tokens)
      @tokens    = tokens.dup
      @length     = tokens.size
      @index = 0
    end

    def next
      raise StopIteration unless @index < @length
      token = @tokens[@index]
      @index += 1
      token
    end

    def peek
      raise StopIteration if @index == @length
      @tokens[@index]
    end

    def rewind
      @index = 0
    end
  end
end

class Weight
  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  # Readers
  def amount
    @amount
  end
  def unit
    @unit
  end

  # Comparison: only defined for same unit
  def ==(other)
    self class == other class && @unit == other.unit && @amount == other.amount
  end

  # Orderable: raises ArgumentError if other unit differs
  def <(other)
    raise ArgumentError if unit != other.unit
    @amount < other.amount
  end

  def <=(other)
    raise ArgumentError if unit != other.unit
    @amount <= other.amount
  end

  def >(other)
    raise ArgumentError if unit != other.unit
    @amount > other.amount
  end

  def >=(other)
    raise ArgumentError if unit != other.unit
    @amount >= other.amount
  end

  # Considered "between"? only if both bounds have same unit
  def between?(lower, upper)
    raise ArgumentError unless lower.unit == unit && upper.unit == unit
    (self >= lower) && (self <= upper)
  end

  # Clamp self to a range that must share the same unit
  def clamp(lower, upper)
    raise ArgumentError unless lower.unit == unit && upper.unit == unit
    min_val = [lower.amount, self.amount].min
    max_val = [upper.amount, self.amount].max
    self.class.new(min_val, unit)
